title: Illustration / Pastels versus gray
slide_intent: Consider the surrounding surface when choosing a light base because a white subject can disappear against a white interface.
strategic_value: Light pastel bases can retain Duolingo’s colorful character while separating pale subjects from white backgrounds.
demonstration: Two paired rows compare tinted wolf and egg illustrations with crossed-out gray versions.
practical_value: Use a light pastel for a pale illustration base instead of white or neutral gray.

content_islands.name: Tinted and gray specimens
content_islands.spec: Place the wolf pair above the egg pair, marking both right-hand gray treatments as rejected.

content_islands.name: Background rationale
content_islands.spec: Explain the white interface background and pastel preference at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects the choice to white app backgrounds and describes gray as cold beside the bright palette.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use light pastels instead of white or gray as illustration base colors.

ingredient.name: Light illustration bases
ingredient.role: Separate pale subjects from white surfaces while retaining color.
ingredient.application: Choose light pastels from the palette for the base rather than white or gray.
ingredient.scope: Historical illustration-base guidance; this does not prohibit gray typography, shadows or every neutral detail elsewhere.
